Only approximate location is used, fetched once each time: when you tap Update location, or (Automatic mode with permission) at most once every 2 hours while a weather widget showing Current location is visible, and it only changes when you move more than 5 km. Nothing runs in the background and nothing is tracked continuously. Choose manually mode needs no permission and never reads your location.
